notes: The classic block-head fighters, with everything that changed how the game plays brought back: the Black Flash only when a finisher lands on the head, the stronger heavy-hit impact frame, the Turf Wars crown reward, turning to face someone before punching, and the natural spins and kicks. Heads now match the body's skin tone and get just as sweaty and shiny during a fight, ears and noses are shaped better, and the referee doesn't do the splits into the floor any more. New lighting: the octagon sits under a bright overhead rig with real shadows and a darker crowd, and the streets glow with lamp light and neon spilling onto the pavement.
